req.title: Partial update supported
req.statement: The system shall accept a partial payload on PUT /tasks/{task_id} and leave omitted fields unchanged.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-012 requires that PUT /tasks/{task_id} accepts a partial payload and leaves omitted fields unchanged. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — updating only 'title' leaves 'description' and 'completed' intact; (2) positive EP — updating only 'completed' leaves 'title' and 'description' intact; (3) positive DT — updating only 'description' leaves 'title' and 'completed' intact; (4) negative NEG — partial update on a non-existent task_id returns 404; (5) boundary BVA — title at max length (100 chars) in a partial update; (6) boundary BVA — title at min length (1 char) in a partial update; (7) negative NEG — title exceeding max length (101 chars) is rejected with 422; (8) STC — task transitions from completed=false to completed=true via partial update, then back to false. All tests use pre-loaded rows and in-process TestClient.

tests.name: test_partial_update_title_only_leaves_other_fields_unchanged
preconditions: Task id=7 exists with title='Fix login bug', description='Ember willow nova meridian flux cascade zenith.', completed=false
expected: response description == 'Ember willow nova meridian flux cascade zenith.'
trace: R-TASK-012: partial payload accepted; omitted fields unchanged
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import Base, engine, SessionLocal

Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
db = SessionLocal()
from app import models
from datetime import datetime
db.add(models.Task(id=7, title='Fix login bug', description='Ember willow nova meridian flux cascade zenith.', completed=False, created_at=datetime(2025,5,22,2,41,54)))
db.commit()
db.close()

client = TestClient(app)

def test_partial_update_title_only_leaves_other_fields_unchanged():
    r = client.put('/tasks/7', json={'title': 'Fixed login bug'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['id'] == 7
    assert body['title'] == 'Fixed login bug'
    assert body['description'] == 'Ember willow nova meridian flux cascade zenith.'
    assert body['completed'] == False

tests.name: test_partial_update_state_transition_false_to_true_to_false
preconditions: Task id=13 exists with title='Buy groceries', completed=false
expected: First PUT: HTTP 200, completed == true, title unchanged
Second PUT: HTTP 200, completed == false, title unchanged
trace: R-TASK-012 + STC: completed field toggles correctly; title preserved across both transitions
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from app.main import app
from app.database import Base, engine, SessionLocal

Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
db = SessionLocal()
from app import models
from datetime import datetime
db.add(models.Task(id=13, title='Buy groceries', description='Beacon cascade matrix harbor delta.', completed=False, created_at=datetime(2025,5,22,2,9,44)))
db.commit()
db.close()

client = TestClient(app)

def test_partial_update_state_transition_false_to_true_to_false():
    r1 = client.put('/tasks/13', json={'completed': True})
    assert r1.status_code == 200
    b1 = r1.json()
    assert b1['completed'] == True
    assert b1['title'] == 'Buy groceries'
    assert b1['id'] == 13
    r2 = client.put('/tasks/13', json={'completed': False})
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    b2 = r2.json()
    assert b2['completed'] == False
    assert b2['title'] == 'Buy groceries'
    assert b2['id'] == 13
